summary: Implemented bounded deterministic TypeScript and Rust Classic-mode game mechanics for future research use, plus an exact recorded-game tape replay path used to validate mobile submissions. The implementations cover the decreasing per-level move clock, 7,000-point rise bonus, numbered and covered incoming discs, explicit hidden values, explicit covered rows, cascades, scoring, legality, and terminal behavior without using future information during policy play.
validationPerformed: npm test: all 145 runnable tests passed and one optional native-binary test skipped, including Classic clock, gray-disc, latent-value, exact cross-engine transition, and explicit-tape replay tests
npm --prefix web test: all tests passed, including server-side Classic submission replay, request-size enforcement, analytics deduplication, and score-claim validation
npm --prefix web run build: Next.js production build and TypeScript checks passed
limitations: The TypeScript and Rust engines pass a shared exact transition conformance case, but the Rust crate is not yet integrated into the repository's native parity suite or a direct whole-trajectory parity harness.
No gameplay benchmark or strategy experiment was run; this contribution establishes mechanics and validation infrastructure only.
Self-reported contribution; not yet independently reviewed.
